description: Named the stitch in the hose, and left the unread page unread.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Counted the second meal, asked with the dish in her hand, and waived a verdict.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Ate, and left the letters to the people who write them.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Named the four lines, kept the long letter, and offered no plot.
name: William Shakespeare
